detail.longDescription:
Need another way to control your TV?

TV Remote Control - Smart TV lets you use your phone to control certain functions on compatible smart TVs. It can be useful when your physical remote is not nearby or available.

Please note: TV Remote Control - Smart TV is a launcher app with built-in smart TV remote features. When selected as your default Home app, it will change the layout of your phone’s home screen. Your installed apps will remain on your device, although some icons or shortcuts may appear in different locations.

You can change your default launcher or uninstall the app at any time through your device settings.

For more information, please visit our FAQ:
https://www.guanlingapps.com/faq.html

📺 TV controls from your home screen

Open the TV remote feature from your phone’s home screen and use it with a compatible smart TV.

Depending on your TV, available controls may include:

• Adjusting the volume
• Changing channels
• Navigating TV menus
• Controlling playback
• Accessing supported TV functions
• Connecting to compatible TVs on the same network

Available controls vary by TV brand, model, platform, and connection method.

🏠 Launcher and home screen features

The launcher provides access to your installed apps and includes additional home screen features.

🕒 Information at a glance

View information such as the time, weather, and news from your home screen. 

🖼️ Wallpapers

Personalize your home screen or lock screen with the available wallpapers.

📡 TV compatibility

TV Remote Control - Smart TV is designed to work with compatible smart TVs and platforms. These may include supported devices from Samsung, Roku, TCL, Google TV, and other providers.

Your phone and TV may need to be connected to the same Wi-Fi network. Available controls, functions, and compatibility vary by TV brand, model, operating system, region, device configuration, and network environment. Some functions may not be available on every compatible TV.

Download TV Remote Control - Smart TV to try the available remote and launcher features on your device.

Independent app notice

TV Remote Control - Smart TV is an independent application and is not affiliated with, sponsored by any TV manufacturer or platform mentioned above.
